early_stopping: Stop after 12 epochs without validation-loss improvement
architecture: DS-CNN 16/24/32, temporal-mean-centered 49x24 log-mel, same as V10
loss: sparse categorical crossentropy; class-balanced sample weights; MSWC negatives and local supplement weighted x2
selection: At least 80% SC STOP recall, <=0.5% SC other-word FP, at least 70% MSWC STOP recall, <=1% MSWC other-word FP, <=5% FP separately for SHORT/START/STARK/SHOP (zero when fewer than 20 validation clips), <=0.5% sampled continuous-negative window FP, zero validation background triggers, >=3/4 local STOP at every prediction phase and zero local negative triggers. Maximize minimum local phase detection, then average SC/MSWC recall, then lower threshold.
test: Expanded public test loaded only after model and threshold frozen; reviewed local test is reused development data
runtime: TFLite BUILTIN_REF, no desktop accelerator delegates
